name: foray-downloads
description: Foray's own Capacitor plugin: downloads an episode's audio for offline listening into the app's own storage, kept out of backups, with a JSON index beside the files. iOS (PQ-20): a background URLSession (identifier ai.jwlabs.foura.downloads) writing into Application Support/foray-downloads/, excluded from backup. Android (PQ-22): the system DownloadManager, landing in getExternalFilesDir(null)/foray-downloads/ (it refuses internal storage) and moved on completion into getNoBackupFilesDir()/foray-downloads/, which Auto Backup skips. Issue #29; docs/roadmap/player-features.md PQ-20/PQ-22. NOT published, NOT a third-party dependency -- this repo's own hand-written native code, same pattern as foray-audio, foray-tts and foray-vault (docs/android-native-code.md). Declared in mobile/package.json (PQ-21), so cap sync compiles it into both shells, and tools/mobile/inject-background-audio.mjs writes the AppDelegate forward of handleEventsForBackgroundURLSession to ForayDownloadsPlugin. Its XCTests run in ci.yml (ios-kit) and its JUnit tests in android-build.yml.
//no-js-entry: No main/module/types on purpose, matching foray-audio, foray-tts and foray-vault. The web half is player/download-bridge.js's createDownloadBridge(), which talks to this plugin through window.Capacitor.nativePromise('ForayDownloads', ...) with the seven calls enqueue/cancel/remove/removeAll/list/usage/fileSrc. There is no bundler in this repo.
